import json, re, unicodedata
SP = r"C:\wt\logos-t423-m8-fable\.ai\scratch\multi_model_bible_chunking\M8_fable\sp_durable"
SPAN = ["Dan.9.%d" % v for v in range(4, 15)]
INNER = ["Dan.9.%d" % v for v in range(4, 14)]  # verses a mark can follow and still stand inside the span
inv = json.load(open(SP + r"\Dan\dan_device_inventory.json", encoding="utf-8"))
print("device inventory, formulae with a verse in 9:4-9:14:")
for k, d in inv["formulae"].items():
    hits = [v for v in d.get("verses_mt", []) if v in SPAN]
    if hits:
        print("  %s: %s" % (k, ", ".join(hits)))
dl = [v for v in inv["datelines"]["verses_mt"] if v in SPAN]
print("device inventory, dateline entries in 9:4-9:14: %d %s" % (len(dl), dl))
print("device inventory, all dateline verses: %s" % ", ".join(inv["datelines"]["verses_mt"]))
pm = json.load(open(SP + r"\Dan\pmarks_Dan.json", encoding="utf-8"))
mk = {v: pm["marks"][v] for v in pm["marks"] if v in INNER}
print("mark layer, section marks after 9:4 to 9:13 (inside the span): %d %s" % (len(mk), mk))
print("mark layer, section mark after 9:3: %s; after 9:14: %s" % (pm["marks"].get("Dan.9.3"), pm["marks"].get("Dan.9.14")))
print("mark layer, chapter 9 verses carrying a section mark: %s" % [v for v in pm["marks"] if v.startswith("Dan.9.")])
def skel(s):
    return "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s) if not ("\u0591" <= c <= "\u05c7"))
osh = {}
for line in open(SP + r"\Dan\Dan_oshb.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n"):
    if "\t" in line:
        r, t = line.split("\t", 1)
        osh[r] = t
yr = [v for v in SPAN if re.search("שנ(?:ה|ת|ים|ות)", skel(osh[v]))]
print("OSHB/WLC, verses of 9:4-9:14 with a year word (inventory substring pattern): %d %s" % (len(yr), yr))
yh = [v for v in SPAN if "יהוה" in skel(osh[v])]
print("OSHB/WLC, verses of 9:4-9:14 holding the divine name: %s" % ", ".join(yh))
rg = [v for v in SPAN if re.search(r"לך\s+אדני\s+הצדקה", skel(osh[v]))]
print("OSHB/WLC, verses of 9:4-9:14 holding the righteousness ascription: %s" % ", ".join(rg))
web = {}
ch = None; cur = None
for line in open(SP + r"\Dan\Dan_web_clean.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n"):
    m = re.match(r"===== DAN (\d+) =====", line)
    if m:
        ch = int(m.group(1)); cur = None; continue
    m = re.match(r"\[v\] (\d+) (.*)", line)
    if m:
        cur = "Dan.%d.%s" % (ch, m.group(1)); web[cur] = m.group(2); continue
    if cur and line.strip() and line.strip() != "\u00b6":
        web[cur] += " " + line.strip()
wy = [v for v in SPAN if re.search(r"(?i)\byears?\b", web[v])]
print("WEB, verses of 9:4-9:14 with the word year or years: %d %s" % (len(wy), wy))
ch9 = [r for r in osh if r.startswith("Dan.9.")]
inspan = [r for r in ch9 if 4 <= int(r.split(".")[2]) <= 14]
print("OSHB/WLC, verse lines of chapter 9: %d; of them in 9:4-9:14: %d" % (len(ch9), len(inspan)))
